mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at overcast skies with a temperature of 69 degrees near Verona City Hall under a waning crescent moon.

The city continues to manage engineering services through AECOM, with reports presented to the City Council regularly. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center is offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail for those looking to enjoy the scenery.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is packed with activities, including trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, while Wednesday features the Downtown Farmer's Market and various trivia options.
In a notable update from the police department, an officer conducted a traffic stop on July 31 which resulted in a driver being arrested for operating while intoxicated, or O W I.
Today's flavor is the delightful Georgia Peach. Culver's is currently closed, but they will open at 10 AM today so you can grab your treat then.
